title: Registered Nurse
summary: Work flexible bank shifts across hospital and community services in Torbay and South Devon. You will assess patients, monitor symptoms and vital signs, arrange diagnostic tests, and respond thoughtfully as clinical situations change. The position requires current nursing registration, recent acute-care experience, compassionate communication, and effective teamwork across several professional disciplines.
responsibilities: Check symptoms and vital signs and arrange diagnostic tests
Make sound decisions as clinical situations change
Work effectively across nursing and interdisciplinary teams
required_qualifications: At least six months of recent paid acute hospital experience
preferred_qualifications: Experience across more than one ward or care setting
